lines: d41: 📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Hazel Reilly is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.
d41: Nobody's talking much. The fire feels smaller tonight.
d41: 🕯️ Hazel is dead — and the dead hold no treaties. Every link Haven has shakes.

d41: Stonebridge watches to see if Haven holds without its dead. The bond is young — they're still deciding what Haven is, and grief delays the verdict. They'll test the link — count on it, unless Haven answers first: send grain (1,500 kcal), send a speaker (2 days), or let the silence answer. (Trust -8.
d41: 🕯️ Hazel Reilly is dead — the expedition. The village stops. Somebody screams. Somebody else starts digging.
d41: What Hazel kept close goes into the ground with them — keepsakes are buried, never taken from the body.
d41: "Hazel's gone." Natalie looks at you for a long moment. "You're not Hazel." No heat in it. Just fact. You'll have to earn this face.
d41: The Codex doesn't pause for grief. Ekin blinks — and it's already there, overlaying everything, syncing. No pen. No paper. The mantle just... transfers.
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Tireless Stride (Level 1). You walk like water downhill — no wasted steps, no wasted breath. Every mile costs 15% less.
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Reading Tracks (Level 1). Fresh tracks have sharp edges. Old tracks crumble. You can tell how recently something passed.
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Stalk (Level 1). Move unseen. Close distance without being noticed.
d41: 🌟 "MANTLE TRANSFER DETECTED. ...Oh! New face! Same job! Whole new set of tricks. We hardly noticed. (That is a lie. We noticed. The audience CRIED.)"
d41: 📖 The Codex turns a page: Hazel Reilly, 41 days. The mantle passes to Ekin Mercan.
d41: 🪞 You wake up somebody else. Ekin Mercan, 26 — a bike messenger. Their hands know different work now: Beast-calm, Echo Location, Dowsing, Green Whisper.
d41: The village's quarrel was with Hazel — and Hazel is dead. The sentence doesn't cross the grave. You're someone else now; the docket is empty, but the village remembers.
d41: At the grave, Natalie, Nasimiyu, Ursula and 1 more speak for Ekin — "Hazel trusted them. We saw it. Give them the fire's hearing." The village listens.
d41: The fire knew Ekin before the Codex did — their name already carried weight here.
